name: Oil Change
intro: Engine oil change procedure. All vessels use Quicksilver 25W-40 semi-synthetic oil. Oil change interval: every 100 engine hours.

help.title: Oil Change Intervals & What Else Is Due
help.body:
Every 100 hours: Change engine oil & filter, grease trim/tilt tube, spray Corrosion Block on fuel tank & engine (inside cowling), steering ram & connection.

Every 200 hours (every other oil change): Also inspect zincs, change fuel filter, change spark plugs, grease trim/tilt.

Every 300 hours: Inspect cooling water flow, change fuel filter.

Every 1000 hours: Replace timing belt (mechanic required).

help.title: Vessel-Specific Oil & Filter Reference
help.body:
SQUID (Yamaha F115B x2):
• Oil: Quicksilver 25W-40 semi-synthetic
• Capacity: 3.8 liters per engine
• Filter: Sahara 1879111
• Available at West Marine

COWFISH (Suzuki DF115B x2):
• Oil: Quicksilver 25W-40 semi-synthetic
• Capacity: 5.5 liters per engine
• Filter: Suzuki 16510-61A31 / Sierra 18-7905-2
• Grease the shifter with grease gun at every oil change (critical to safety)
• Available at West Marine

BLU Q (Honda BFP60 x2):
• Oil: Quicksilver 25W-40 semi-synthetic
• Capacity: 2.9 quarts per engine (when filter is changed)
• Filter: Sierra 18-7911-1
• Available at West Marine

items.label: Is this a 200-hour service? (every other oil change)
items.info: At 200 hours, also inspect zincs, change fuel filter, change spark plugs, and grease trim/tilt.

help.title: 200-Hour Service Checklist
help.body:
In addition to the standard oil change, a 200-hour service includes:

1. Inspect and replace zincs if needed
   • SQUID: Bracket 6G5-45251-01, Lower unit 6E5-45371-01-00
   • COWFISH: Bracket 55320-94900, Lower unit 55321-90J01
2. Change fuel filter
   • SQUID: Sierra 18-7866 Extra Capacity, 10 Micron
   • COWFISH: High pressure fuel filter (mechanic for 1000hr)
   • BLU Q: Sierra 18-7866 / 18-7945 Spin-on XL
3. Change spark plugs
   • SQUID: NGK LKR6E (gap 0.8-0.9mm)
   • BLU Q: NGK LMAR6C-9 (need 14mm deep socket)
4. Grease trim/tilt tube

items.label: Run engine for 5 minutes to warm oil
Kill engine and wait 2 minutes for oil to settle
Remove drain plug and drain oil into container
items.info: Use a clean container. Note the color and condition of old oil — dark/gritty may indicate a problem.

items.label: Replace oil filter
items.info: Pre-fill new filter with clean oil before installing. Lubricate the gasket with a thin coat of oil.

items.label: Replace drain plug — hand tight + 1/4 turn
items.info: Do not over-tighten. A new crush washer is recommended if available.

items.label: Add new oil to fill line
items.info: SQUID: 3.8L per engine | COWFISH: 5.5L per engine | BLU Q: 2.9qt per engine

items.label: Amount of oil added
COWFISH ONLY: Grease the shifter with grease gun
items.info: Critical to safety. Must be done at every oil change on the Cowfish.

help.title: Why this matters
help.body: The Cowfish Suzuki DF115B shifters require grease at every oil change. Failure to grease can cause the shifter mechanism to seize, which is a safety hazard. Use a standard grease gun.

items.label: Check oil level on dipstick — between marks
Start engine, run for 2 minutes, check for leaks
items.info: Watch around the drain plug and filter for any drips.

items.label: Recheck level after running — top off if needed
Old oil condition
items.info: Milky oil or metal flakes require immediate follow-up. Do NOT run the engine.
